message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of the sections and contents assembled in an LLM context window.","description":"A tall, rounded rectangular outline contains three vertically stacked sections, each identified by a gray rounded header. “System Prompt” lists agent definition and goals, tool documentation, sub-agent documentation, and system instructions. “Core Prompt” lists the problem statement or instruction, open files, and directory tree. “Assistant Messages” lists CoT reasoning, tool calls and results, sub-agent calls and results, and overseer notifications. The page context labels the overall structure as an LLM context window.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
